biggest_catch: We Are Rosie handpicks marketers per project — joining the community never guarantees any assignment.
catches: They handpick each Rosie for each project; joining does not guarantee any assignment.
Project pay is set per assignment and negotiated via your profile preferences — no fixed rate.
Assignments range 1–24 months; steady income depends on landing back-to-back roles.
Competition exists within the 35,000+ marketer community.

c1.evidence: We Are Rosie's official join page states: 'Joining the Rosies is easy! Sign up here, then fill out your profile with your experience, skills, ideal work conditions (pay, remote vs in person, etc.), and start browsing open opportunities.' Flexible job opportunities range '1 to 24 months, full-time, fractional, part-time, or project-based' — a live, provider-owned deal channel for marketing freelancers.

c2.evidence: Official FAQ: 'We tailor every project to your specific needs and goals, so we don't have a set rate.' Pay is per assignment — variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: sign up, complete your profile, browse open opportunities on the Rosie portal, apply; their talent team reviews applications.

c4.evidence: Official pages: 'Join our community for free' — no fee to join or apply.

eligibility: Marketing professionals of all genders and identities with marketable marketing skills (creative, strategy, media, etc.).
notes: Scenario: vetted marketing freelancer matching. We Are Rosie connects a 35,000+ marketer community with flexible, remote-friendly assignments from Fortune 500 brands and agencies (1–24 months, full-time, fractional, part-time, or project-based), handling contracts and payroll. Joining is free; pay is per assignment — variable, never guaranteed.
